title: selaginella geniculata
intro: Selaginella geniculata, commonly known as "False Asparagus Fern," is a species of spore-producing plant in the family Selaginellaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Amazonian region, due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella geniculata include its ability to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, although further research is needed to fully understand the plant's properties and potential applications.
